title: Genjutsu
body:
Syntax: perform <jutsu name> <target>

Description: One of the four primary classes (see 'help classes'). Genjutsu techniques deal mental damage and often carry a lingering status effect, and (like Ninjutsu) require hand signs and a real casting delay before they land.

Jutsu unlocks expand across levels 5-65: Henge disguises, object illusions, disorientation and control attacks, Chisei, and room-wide Nehan Shōja. Use 'skills' or 'prac' for your complete level-sorted roster; 'help <jutsu name>' explains each technique.

Date: 2026-08-26
